title: Adjacent-protection violation, then nothing recorded for 21 days
detail: Checked DOB, ECB and safety violations and DOB complaints (code 03) on the site and 5 touching lots, dated in the year before 2026-06-01.

title: Stop-work order, then a violation for continuing work
detail: Checked violation text and 311 resolutions on the site and 5 touching lots, dated in the year before 2026-06-01.

title: Structural complaint within 90 days of earth work next door
detail: 1 earth-work, foundation or SOE filing on the site or a touching lot. No complaint in codes 30, 14, 16 or 5C on a lot next to it within 90 days of its filing or permit, before 2026-06-01.

title: Heavy rain or freeze-thaw during an open excavation
detail: No earth-work, foundation or SOE permit on the site was issued before 2026-06-01, so there was no open excavation to check the weather against.
